description: Later systems are populated from earlier ones, so the first version of your data becomes the authoritative one regardless of whether it was right.

aspect: Nobody can tell you where it started
description: By the time it surfaces, four organisations hold the same wrong value and each cites one of the others as the source.

aspect: SCENARIO - the wrong digit in the date of birth
description: A clinic types 1987 instead of 1978. Eleven years later it surfaces as a mismatch on an insurance claim, and proving the original is wrong falls to the patient, who has no copy of a form filled in by someone else in 2014.
energy_note: Disproving a document you never saw.

description: Two digits swapped on a transfer. The money arrives in a real account belonging to a real stranger. Recovery depends on that stranger agreeing, and the bank will not identify them.
energy_note: Your money, in a named account, unreachable.

description: Change-of-detail requests trigger anti-fraud controls the original error never did, so the honest fix is scrutinised more than the mistake.

aspect: SCENARIO - the address that never updated
description: One utility keeps the old address. Two years later a debt collector has a judgment for a bill posted to a house he left in 2021, and the first he hears is a refusal.
energy_note: Judged in absence, by post sent to the wrong door.

description: Mistyping your own email on a booking, your own IBAN on a form, your own postcode on an order. Same mechanism, same cost, and no one to escalate to.
